description: Search public cancer genomics studies in cBioPortal (TCGA, CPTAC, MSK, etc.) by keyword. Matches study name, study id, or cancer-type id (case-insensitive). Returns study ids, names, cancer types, and sample counts. Keyless, open data.

query.description: Keyword to match against study name / id / cancer type (e.g. "breast", "tcga", "glioma"). Omit to list studies.

name: cbioportal_search_studies
title: Cbioportal Search Studies
